claims.title: Finite top-set selection and simultaneous weighted bad-orbit mass
claims.statement: For delta|H|>=16, Chebyshev and Markov select one subset of size between delta|H|/2 and 2delta|H| with exactly the source TopsOK weighted cost, including zero cost. An elementary factorial bound gives sum_(p<y)log(p)/p<=2log(y); consequently the selected subset has simultaneous bad mass<=|T|x^(-2+epsilon) eventually. If this same subset is the arithmetic host subset, it gives actual adm2.
assumptions: Nonnegative finite prime weights and the GII9 pointwise BadProb bound.
For actual adm2, the chosen subset and steps must be identified with the arithmetic host; that transport is explicitly separate.
